name: Mace of Terror
description: A black iron mace with a head shaped like a screaming face.
body:
## What it does

It holds three charges and regains 1d3 each dawn. Spend one, as an action, to send out a wave of dread: each creature you choose within 30 feet makes a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or is frightened of you for a minute. A frightened creature spends its turns running from you, cannot come within 30 feet of you willingly and takes no reactions. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.
